items.summary: Abhishek Sharma celebrated his century against New Zealand while responding to Yuvraj Singh’s playful reminder. Yuvraj highlighted his record of a 12-ball fifty during the exchange. Nepal's Dipendra Singh Airee set a new record in 2023 with a nine-ball fifty. Abhishek emphasized team goals over personal milestones in his innings. India secured a convincing victory with Abhishek’s performance, leading the series 3-0.

items.title: Microsoft employees in India can now opt for a buyout: Who qualifies and what it pays
items.title_zh: 印度的微软员工现在可以选择收购：谁符合资格以及支付多少钱
items.summary: Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 employees, over a quarter of its workforce, in India, the US, the UK and Canada. HR head Amy Coleman announced the Voluntary Exit Offer in a memo to staff. The package matches standard severance, which can run up to 39 weeks of pay. Xbox, Copilot and Windows teams are eligible, sales is excluded, and the deadline is December.

items.title: DC court lets grandmother seek protection order against grandchildren's mother
items.title_zh: 华盛顿特区法院允许祖母针对孙辈的母亲寻求保护令
items.summary: In a significant ruling, the D.C. Court of Appeals has reinstated a civil protection order filed by grandmother Fonda Allen against her grandchildren's biological mother, Tamieka Whitehead. Allen, who holds legal custody, accused Whitehead of verbal abuse and harassment. This decision clarifies familial definitions under the Intrafamily Offenses Act, allowing the case to proceed after a prior dismissal based on jurisdiction.

items.title: YouTube scam hunters help identify suspects in alleged $65m US elderly scam
items.title_zh: YouTube诈骗猎人帮助识别涉嫌$ 6500万美国老年人诈骗的嫌疑人
items.summary: An elaborate fraud scheme has bilked elderly Americans out of approximately $65 million. The operation, which was traced back to India-based call centers and fake personas, preyed on victims to send money through wire transfers and gift cards. YouTube creators played a crucial role in this investigation by unmasking the scammers and documenting their exploits. Consequently, multiple arrests have been made, with legal actions against the offenders continuing.

items.title: After rats and pigs removed, sea turtles return to Pacific island after decades
items.title_zh: 去除老鼠和猪后，海龟在几十年后返回太平洋岛屿
items.summary: Nu’utele Island in Samoa is witnessing a remarkable revival as invasive rats and pigs have been eradicated. This positive shift has encouraged the resurgence of native bird species and provided safe nesting grounds for sea turtles. Furthermore, local communities are experiencing enhanced food production linked to the restoration of native plants. Such revitalization underscores the critical need for ongoing conservation efforts to safeguard biodiversity and combat climate change effects.
